T3:3:0.text: Helpless as a beetle when his back went

T3:5:0.text: Laid up: worse for knowing what he was missing

T3:5:1.text: Sure the old hands would say he had not lasted

T3:7:0.text: Overcome to find his potatoes lifted and labelled by others

T3:11:0.text: A man no longer only what he can do

T3:15:0.text: On the rake: no longer new or watched

T3:17:0.text: Trusted with an old hand's grief

T3:19:0.text: Not proud to hear himself go quiet at a newcomer, as they did to him

T3:21:0.text: Uneasy and a bit pleased to be an insider

T3:21:1.text: Hearing himself pass on what Frank did to him

T3:23:0.text: Glad to be asked, his March rule on asking gone

T3:25:0.text: Neighbours of eleven years met at last over a bag of potatoes

T3:27:0.text: Home from the plot with news of his own for Pat

T3:31:0.text: Seen by Pat in his own work at last

T3:35:0.text: Winter feared as a Sunday night at the bus station

T3:35:1.text: A winter hope: told to come Wednesdays

groups.label: Laid low, then carried by the old hands as one of them
groups.description: A fortnight sure he had not lasted, then let in without a word, and worth found in more than what he can do

groups.label: Hearing himself go quiet at the gate: an old hand now
groups.description: Uneasy and a bit pleased at the newcomer, handing on Frank's ways, and glad to be asked

groups.label: Seen and heard at home at last, through the plot
groups.description: News of his own for Pat, Pat seeing his work, and neighbours met over potatoes

groups.label: Surplus no more, except in the winter flat
groups.description: Not surplus at the plot, and winter feared as a Sunday night at the bus station

groups.label: Laid up, and sure he had not lasted
groups.description: Felled in the shed, the part left over again, and the gate's verdict feared

groups.label: Let in without a word, from his potatoes to the rake
groups.description: His potatoes lifted and labelled while he was laid up, help heard as belonging, the rake at the bonfire, Frank's grief seen, and Wednesdays in Frank's shed

groups.label: Worth no longer only in what he can do
groups.description: Nothing looked for wrong in their work, half sacks without shame, and the back sure to go again

quoted.T3:9:0: "a year ago, if somebody had dug my plot, that's what I'd have heard. I'd have been ashamed. … And this time it was the other way round. … You don't dig for somebody who's not one of you."
quoted.T3:19:0: "we all stopped talking. All three of us. Me with them. And I heard us do it. I heard myself go quiet, the same as they did to me."
quoted.T3:27:0: "She says I come back from the plot with things to say. … I didn't have things to say before. … A man needs a bit of news of his own, I think."
quoted.T3:39:1: "And I'm not the part left over. Not down there. Up in the flat, some days, still, I won't lie. But not down there."
